name: Shingopana
sum: Shingopana is a small aeolosaurin titanosaur from the Galula Formation of Tanzania, up to about 8 m long.
wsnote: Up to about 8 m when fully grown (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; damaged by insect bore holes soon after death.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Gorscak et al. 2017
